items.title: Here’s the Real Problem With Stock Buybacks
items.summary: Warren Buffett  is normally courteous, but he had some choice words for critics of stock buybacks a few years ago.  Companies need to return cash to investors eventually to be worth owning.  Companies that grant lots of stock options can be indifferent because they want to soak up those cheaply issued shares.
